A **Symbolic link** makes an object that is defined elsewhere appear in another place, **without duplicating it**. The target objects are rendered where the link is, and editing the original updates every place that links to it.
**Traceability**
- *Can be traced from other objects:* **No**. Its only class is `symbolic-link`, not `traceable-object`, and symbolic links cannot point to other symbolic links. - *Can have traces to other objects:* **Yes**. Its *Link* trace (type `:Proteus-link`) can point to one or more objects of **any class**, even ones that are not traceable objects, **except** sections, appendices and other symbolic links.
